thread:
hannah: heads-up 1:30 egress hardening in us-west-2 caused warm-pool nodes to fail keystore handshakes. warm-pool 0/40 for ~38m.

mike: paste log?

hannah: 
```
2026-04-10T21:28:03Z gpu-node-81 keystore: decrypt err=KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED code=403 attempt=2
2026-04-10T21:28:05Z gpu-node-81 http: POST https://audit-shipper.internal/v1/logs -> 403 Forbidden
```

security-bot: 403 likely from deny-by-default egress. controlplane IPs were allowlisted but ephemeral NAT ENIs for warm-pool not included.

mike: impact: autoscaler diverted load to eu, approximate extra egress $1.4k during incident.

hannah: mitigation options: revert, subnet CIDR allow, or ENI-targeted allow via lambda. prefer ENI-targeted.

keystore-bot: action:apply-allowlist --subnet subnet-warm-usw2 --endpoints kms.us-west-2.internal,audit-shipper.internal --scope ENI --ttl 2h :white_check_mark:

mike: spinning 3 canary nodes. watch keystore.decrypt.latency and warm_pool.fill_time. Also add alert: kms.5xx_rate > 1% for 5m.

hannah: canary 3/3 joined, decrypt.latency median 140ms -> warm-pool recovered.

mike: next: RFC to centralize keystore egress through controlplane static ENI or managed NAT; firewall CI to simulate ENI churn. compliance: document exception and approver in audit logs for 180d.

hannah: I'll draft the postmortem and runbook. closing after RFC opened. :thumbsup:
